senses.gloss: to press upon; to arrogate superiority; to humiliate, insult.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 36b">Gitt. 36ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 23a:3">Yoma 23ᵃ</cite> <he>הנֶעֱלָבִין ואינן עוֹלְבִין וכ׳</he> those who are insulted, and do not insult, hear themselves reviled &c., v. <cite ref="H01743"><he>חֶרְפָּה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 88b:2">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>עֲלוּבִין וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>הנעלבין</he>).—V. <cite ref="P00774"><he>עָלוּב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be insulted, submit to humiliation, v. supra.
